key_decisions.rationale: Keeps shared knowledge, concealment, partial amount, and placement.
key_decisions.before: He kept back part of the proceeds for himself, with his wife’s knowledge, and brought only part of the money and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
key_decisions.after: With his wife’s knowledge, he kept back some of the price for himself. Then he brought only part and laid it at the apostles’ feet.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: and kept back part of the proceeds, his wife also knowing, and bringing a certain part, he laid it at the feet of the apostles.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves address, Satan, filled heart, lie, Spirit, and withheld money.
key_decisions.before: Peter said, “Ananias, why has Satan filled your heart so that you lied to the Holy Spirit and kept back part of the price of the land?
key_decisions.after: Peter asked, “Ananias, why has Satan filled your heart so that you lied to the Holy Spirit and kept back some of the field’s price?
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But Peter said, “Ananias, why has Satan filled your heart to lie to the Holy Spirit and to keep back part of the proceeds of the land?

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps ownership before sale, control afterward, heart intention, and God as offended party.
key_decisions.before: While it remained unsold, did it not remain yours? And after it was sold, was not the money under your authority? Why did you put this thing in your heart? You have not lied to people but to God.”
key_decisions.after: While it remained unsold, didn’t it remain yours? And after it was sold, wasn’t the money under your authority? Why did you conceive this deed in your heart? You have not lied to people but to God.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: While it remained, did it not remain yours? And after it was sold, was it not in your authority? Why is it that you have conceived this thing in your heart? You have not lied to men but to God.”

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves immediate collapse, death, and public fear.
key_decisions.before: When Ananias heard these words, he fell down and breathed his last. Great fear came over everyone who heard about it.
key_decisions.after: When Ananias heard these words, he fell down and died. Great fear came upon everyone who heard about it.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And hearing these words, Ananias fell down and breathed his last, and great fear came upon all who heard.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves shared conspiracy, testing, Spirit, husband, ominous feet, and prediction.
key_decisions.before: Peter said to her, “Why did you agree together to test the Spirit of the Lord? Look—the feet of those who buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out too.”
key_decisions.after: Peter said to her, “Why did the two of you agree to test the Spirit of the Lord? Look, the feet of those who buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out too.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: But Peter said to her, “Why is it that you have agreed together to test the Spirit of the Lord? Behold, the feet of those who have buried your husband are at the door, and they will carry you out.”

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps immediate death, discovery, removal, burial, and marital location.
key_decisions.before: Immediately she fell down at his feet and breathed her last. The young men came in, found her dead, carried her out, and buried her beside her husband.
key_decisions.after: Immediately she fell down at his feet and died. When the young men came in, they found her dead, carried her out, and buried her beside her husband.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And immediately she fell down at his feet and breathed her last. And the young men came in and found her dead, and carrying her out, they buried her beside her husband.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves fear, church, and broader hearers.
key_decisions.before: Great fear came over the whole church and everyone who heard about these things.
key_decisions.after: Great fear came upon the whole church and everyone who heard about these things.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And great fear came upon the whole church and upon all who heard these things.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps contrast, growth, faith, Lord, multitudes, and both genders.
key_decisions.before: Yet more and more people who trusted in the Lord were added, multitudes of both men and women.
key_decisions.after: Yet more and more believers in the Lord—large numbers of both men and women—were added to them.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: And more than ever believers were being added to the Lord, multitudes of both men and women,

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves response, sick people, locations, bedding variety, Peter, shadow, and hope without asserting mechanism.
key_decisions.before: People even carried the sick into the streets and laid them on beds and mats so that when Peter passed by, at least his shadow might fall on some of them.
key_decisions.after: As a result, people carried the sick into the streets and laid them on small beds and mats so that when Peter came by, at least his shadow might fall on some of them.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: so that they even carried out the sick into the streets and laid them on beds and mats, so that as Peter came by at least his shadow might overshadow some of them.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps parties, retrieval, restraint, reason, crowd, and threatened stoning.
key_decisions.before: The captain went with the officers and brought them back, but without violence because they were afraid the people might stone them.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps emphatic order, avoided name, citywide teaching, intention, and blood responsibility claim.
key_decisions.before: “Did we not strictly command you not to teach in this name? And look—you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching, and you intend to bring this man’s blood upon us.”
key_decisions.after: saying, “We strictly ordered you not to teach in this name, yet look—you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching and intend to bring this man’s blood upon us.”
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: saying, “Did we not strictly command you not to teach in this name? And behold, you have filled Jerusalem with your teaching and intend to bring this man’s blood upon us.”

key_decisions.after: The God of our ancestors raised Jesus, whom you killed by hanging him on a tree.

key_decisions.rationale: Preserves hearing, visceral anger, intention, and lethal threat.

key_decisions.after: When they heard this, they were enraged and wanted to kill the apostles.

key_decisions.rationale: Keeps name, self-claim, approximate number and gender, death, scattering, and failure.

key_decisions.after: Some time ago Theudas rose up, claiming to be somebody, and about four hundred men joined him. He was killed, and all who followed him were scattered and came to nothing.
key_decisions.tsw_comparator: For before these days Theudas rose up, claiming to be somebody, to whom a number of men, about four hundred, joined themselves; he was killed, and all who were following him were dispersed and came to nothing.
